name: Email Channel Extension
description: Bidirectional email integration: send through SMTP or Resend's HTTPS API; read, search, extract verification codes, reply, move, label, flag and delete through IMAP; keep a suppression record and unsubscribe tokens on a SQL database.
features: Send emails with text, HTML, and attachments via SMTP or Resend's HTTPS API
Read inbox and other IMAP folders
Search emails by query, folder, and date range
Extract verification codes and OTPs from email bodies
Reply to email threads maintaining conversation context
Read every recipient, the threading and authentication headers, bounded text and HTML parts and attachments after a UID; move, label, flag and delete one message by UID
Keep a suppression record and opaque unsubscribe tokens, stored as hashes, on a SQL database
